title: The Sun and Life
text_content:
The sun gives light and heat to Earth.
Plants use sunlight to make food.
Animals eat plants or other animals.
Because of this, all living things depend on the sun.
Without the sun, life would not exist.

title: Dogs as Pets
text_content:
Dogs are popular pets around the world.
They help people by guarding homes.
Some dogs are trained to guide people who cannot see.
Dogs also give comfort and friendship.
This is why many families love dogs.

title: Water Cycle
text_content:
Water moves in a cycle on Earth.
The sun heats water and turns it into vapor.
This vapor forms clouds in the sky.
When clouds get heavy, rain falls.
This process repeats again and again.

title: Bird Migration
text_content:
Some birds travel long distances every year.
They move to warmer places when it gets cold.
This journey is called migration.
Birds return when the weather becomes warm again.
Migration helps them survive.

title: Healthy Eating
text_content:
Eating healthy food helps the body grow strong.
Fruits and vegetables give vitamins.
Too much junk food can harm the body.
Drinking enough water is also important.
A balanced diet keeps people healthy.

title: Trees and Air
text_content:
Trees play an important role in the environment.
They take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
People and animals need oxygen to breathe.
Trees also help keep the air clean.
This is why planting trees is important.

title: Fish Adaptations
text_content:
Fish live in water and have special body parts.
Their gills help them breathe underwater.
Fins help them swim and balance.
Some fish have colors to hide from enemies.
These features help fish survive.

title: Why We Go to School
text_content:
School is a place where children learn many things.
They study reading, math, and science.
Teachers guide students in their learning.
Students also learn how to work with others.
School prepares them for the future.

title: Types of Rain
text_content:
Rain can fall in different ways.
Light rain falls slowly and softly.
Heavy rain falls fast and can flood areas.
Some rain comes with strong winds.
Different types of rain affect people in different ways.

title: Bicycles and Safety
text_content:
Bicycles are useful for travel and exercise.
Riders should wear helmets to protect their heads.
They must follow road rules for safety.
Using lights at night helps others see them.
Safety keeps riders protected.

title: Fruits and Health
text_content:
Fruits are important for a healthy body.
They provide vitamins and minerals.
Eating different fruits gives more nutrients.
Fruits also help the body fight sickness.
That is why fruits should be eaten daily.

title: Earth’s Layers
text_content:
The Earth has different layers.
The outer layer is called the crust.
Below it is the mantle, which is very hot.
The center is the core, which is even hotter.
These layers make up the Earth.

title: Air Pollution
text_content:
Air pollution happens when harmful gases enter the air.
Smoke from cars and factories causes pollution.
Dirty air can make people sick.
Plants and animals are also affected.
Keeping the air clean is important for everyone.

title: Clothing and Weather
text_content:
Clothing helps protect the body from weather.
People wear light clothes in hot weather.
In cold weather, they wear thick clothes.
Raincoats keep people dry in the rain.
Choosing the right clothes keeps people comfortable.

title: Transportation and Travel
text_content:
Transportation helps people travel easily.
Cars are used for short distances.
Trains and planes are used for long trips.
Each type of transport has its own use.
Choosing the right one saves time and effort.
